description:

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to  hundreds of thousands of businesses  and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. .

title: Data Governance Analyst
description:
Data Ideology
At DI, we provide Data & Analytics expertise to drive measurable business outcomes, often solving complex business problems for our clients. Our data analytics advisory services enable our customers to transform data into insights by driving a culture of empowerment and ownership of results. Our team consists of highly motivated individuals passionate about learning, understanding, collaborating, and intellectually curious. For more information about Data Ideology , visit
Data Governance Analyst
We are seeking a hands-on Data Governance Analyst to operate at the intersection of data governance, analytics, technology, and the business. This is not a policy-only governance role. The ideal candidate will work directly with business and technology stakeholders to understand data, document and improve how it is governed, analyze issues, and turn governance objectives into practical solutions.The right person will be comfortable moving between stakeholder conversations, data definitions, data quality, metadata, SQL-based analysis, reporting, and governance processes.
What Success Looks Like
The successful candidate will help the organization make its data more:

• Trusted

• Understandable

• Consistent

• Accessible to the right people

• Measurable

• Governed in a practical, usable way

They should be able to take an ambiguous data problem, work with stakeholders to understand it, dig into the underlying data where necessary, and drive the issue toward resolution.For more information about Data Ideology , visit www.dataideology.com
Responsibilities
To perform in this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. Other duties may be assigned to meet business needs.

• Partner with business, data, technology, and governance stakeholders to identify and address data governance needs.

• Facilitate conversations with data owners and subject-matter experts to establish definitions, ownership, standards, and appropriate usage of data.

• Support development and maintenance of business glossaries, data dictionaries, metadata, data standards, and governance documentation.

• Assist with data quality initiatives by identifying, analyzing, documenting, and helping remediate data issues.

• Perform hands-on data analysis using SQL or similar tools to investigate governance and data-quality questions.

• Analyze datasets to validate business rules, definitions, completeness, consistency, and accuracy.

• Help translate business requirements into measurable data rules and governance requirements.

• Support data access, sharing, and usage-governance processes.

• Build or maintain reporting, dashboards, or metrics that provide visibility into data quality and governance activities.

• Work across teams to improve governance workflows and reduce manual or inefficient processes.

• Communicate findings clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

• Help move governance initiatives from discussion and documentation into repeatable operational processes.

Supervisory Responsibilities: None
Qualifications
Education and Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field required. Advanced degree preferred.

• Approximately 2-5 years of experience in data governance, data analytics, business/data analysis, or a related discipline.

• Experience working directly with business stakeholders, data owners, technical teams, or senior leadership.

• Strong Plus

• Experience in banking, financial services, or another regulated industry.

• Experience with enterprise data governance or data-quality platforms.

• Familiarity with Informatica or comparable governance/data-quality tooling.

• Experience with cloud data platforms or modern data environments.

• Experience automating data, reporting, or governance workflows.

title: Partner-Manager:in Lernprogramme
description: Worum es geht Mit Coachweave macht die Teachlume GmbH aus dem Wissen von Coaches, Trainer:innen und Berater:innen digitale Lernprogramme, die Menschen über Wochen begleiten. Produziert wird mit einer eigenen KI-Kette: Strukturvorschläge, Kurse, Bilder, Stimmen, Übersetzungen. Was die KI nicht kann: verstehen, was ein Coach wirklich braucht, beurteilen, ob ein Programm wirkt, und es so bauen, dass es sich trägt. Dafür suchen wir dich. Die Nachfrage wächst gerade schneller, als unser Gründer allein Gespräche führen kann. Was du machst Du führst Erstgespräche mit Coaches und findest heraus, was sie wirklich brauchen. Wenn es nicht passt, sagst du es freundlich. Du hältst die Pipeline in Bewegung: viele Partner parallel, jeder mit klarem nächsten Schritt. Du prüfst, was unsere KI aus Gesprächen und Material erstellt (Strukturvorschläge, PDFs, Kurse), gibst ihr präzises Feedback und gibst frei, wenn es gut ist. Du besprichst die Ergebnisse mit den Partnern und entwickelst die Programme mit ihnen weiter. Du denkst Programme wirtschaftlich: Preis, Einstieg, Abo, Upgrade, und was Lernende dranhält. Nach dem Start schaust du, was funktioniert, und machst daraus die nächste Staffel. Was du mitbringst Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Beratung oder Partner- und Kundenbetreuung mit eigener Verantwortung, gern in Coaching, Weiterbildung, EdTech oder SaaS. Du arbeitest strukturiert mit vielen Beteiligten gleichzeitig und lässt nichts liegen. Du rechnest gern nach, ob ein Modell trägt. Du weißt, wie Menschen lernen und dranbleiben; Erfahrung in L&D ist ein Plus, den Rest lernst du bei uns. Du erkennst, wenn ein Text oder Konzept nicht trägt, und kannst genau sagen, warum. Mit KI-Werkzeugen arbeitest du selbstverständlich.

title: Security Engineer - US
description:
Description
Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that leverages runtime context to identify and prioritize critical risks, providing precise insights and efficient cloud security management. Unlike traditional tools, Upwind uses runtime data proactively for risk prioritization and posture insights, ensuring teams focus on what truly matters. With industry-leading efficiency and eBPF-powered sensors, Upwind delivers comprehensive capabilities, including agentless cloud posture discovery, real-time threat protection, and integrated API security. From misconfigurations to malware defense, Upwind ensures end-to-end, cost-effective cloud infrastructure protection. At Upwind, you’ll have the opportunity to think creatively, explore new ideas, and use your skills to make a meaningful impact on our growth.
We are looking for a Security Engineer to join our MDR team as the founding U.S. member of the Security organization. In this role, you will be part of our security function, focusing on proactive reviews and providing advanced guidance to customers, while independently owning U.S.-hours coverage. This is an opportunity to bring deep cloud security expertise to a fast-growing team, working closely with analysts, researchers, and engineers - with a clear path toward technical or team leadership as the U.S. presence scales.
Responsibilities

• Assist in fine-tuning Upwind's detection and response mechanisms.

• Support proactive reviews of customer environments to identify risks, exposed attack surfaces, and recommend improvements.

• Lead and conduct in-depth security investigations - including supply chain, API, malware, and runtime attack scenarios - documenting outcomes and developing playbooks to enhance future detection and response.

• Collaborate with Security Analysts, Research, and Backend teams to enhance detection quality.

• Own the handling of complex or critical incidents escalated from Tier 1/2, including live, high-pressure engagements with customers.

• Participate in recurring customer meetings, helping translate security findings into clear, actionable recommendations - and maintain composure when conversations get tense.

• Stay up to date with emerging threats, attack techniques, attack surfaces, and best practices in cloud security.

• Contribute to the development and training of AI-driven detection models, leveraging machine learning to improve investigation accuracy and response efficiency.

Requirements

• Visa sponsorship is not available.

• This role includes participating in a shared on-call rotation. While escalations are infrequent, team members are expected to be available for nights, weekends, or holidays during their rotation week.

• Solid, hands-on experience in cybersecurity, ideally from a leading cloud or cloud security company, with real-world exposure to cloud environments.

• Strong working knowledge of detection engineering, incident response, and threat analysis, with the ability to explain attack techniques (supply chain, API, malware, runtime) in depth.

• Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and container technologies (Docker/Kubernetes).

• Familiarity with networking fundamentals and scripting (Python/Bash).

• Strong communication and presentation skills, with proven ability to engage directly with customers - including staying composed under pressure or pushback.

• Self-directed and comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment.

title: Engineering Lead
description:
Engineering Lead
Large, Complex Federal Government Program | Full-Time W-2 | Fully Remote (U.S.)
The Problem We're Hiring You to Solve
Monthly production releases. Zero escaped critical defects. Most engineering organizations treat those as a tradeoff. On this program they are both commitments, measured every release, in front of the customer.
We are hiring the engineering leader who builds an organization that delivers both at once: multiple cross-functional development teams modernizing a federal home loan benefit platform while sustaining the 20-year-old system it replaces. If you believe speed and quality are the same discipline practiced well, and you have the delivery record to prove it, keep reading.
The Opportunity
Most engineering leadership roles ask you to protect a delivery machine someone else built. This one asks you to build the machine.
The program spans multiple development teams working in parallel across a modern platform (Salesforce-centered, configuration-first, supplemented by serverless capabilities in a government cloud) and a legacy suite that must stay stable until it is decommissioned. Work arrives through a formal intake process that turns business needs into executable plans with committed scope, timelines, and team sizing in days. Then your organization delivers against those commitments, publicly and measurably.
The quality bar is unusually explicit. Every release ships with 100% automated test coverage for its features before user acceptance testing begins. Defect detection before UAT must exceed 95%. Escaped critical defects must be zero. Critical production bugs get fixed in three days. Accessibility and security compliance are release gates, not aspirations. These are not stretch goals on a slide. They are how the program measures the engineering organization every month.
That bar is exactly why this role is interesting. Hitting it once takes heroics. Hitting it every month takes an engineering system: disciplined definition of done, test automation as a first-class craft, engineers who own quality instead of throwing code over a wall, and a leader who builds all of that into how teams work rather than inspecting it in afterward. That leader is you.
You will work alongside a Senior DevSecOps & Platform Engineering Lead who owns the delivery pipeline and an Enterprise Solution Architect who owns the designs. You own the organization that turns those designs into shipped, tested, production software.
What You'll Own

• The engineering organization. Lead multiple cross-functional development teams across modern and legacy platforms, flexing team size and composition as workflows through intake. Teams form, deliver, and re-form around the work. You make that fluid instead of chaotic.

• Delivery you put your name on. Commit to scope, level of effort, and timelines in executable plans, then hit them. When you cannot, say so early, with a recovery plan, before the customer discovers it.

• A quality system, not a QA gate. Engineer quality into how teams work: definition of done that includes full automated testing, code review that catches problems, and metrics that surface risk early. The outcomes that prove it: zero escaped critical defects, defect detection above 95% before UAT, and critical fixes inside three days.

• Test automation as a craft. Build the discipline where every feature ships with complete positive and negative automated coverage, and the regression suite becomes the safety net the customer trusts enough to focus UAT on new functionality only.

• The monthly release drumbeat. Production value ships every 30 days or faster, release after release, without burning the team down to do it.

• Dual-stack engineering. Run modern configuration-first platform development and legacy sustainment side by side, including the warranty on everything your teams release.

title: Senior Cybersecurity Compliance Analyst
description:
About APTNEXUS

Since our founding 2012, APTNEXUS has empowered federal agencies and commercial enterprises to navigate the complexities of the digital landscape. As a quality-driven small business, we specialize in the seamless delivery of IT modernization and elite cybersecurity solutions. We help our clients modernize and fortify their technology stacks -ensuring their most critical data and assets remain resilient, optimized, and secure in an evolving threat environment.

Clearance:

Ability to obtain and maintain a Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) for our Department of Treasury customer. Candidates must reside in, and perform all work from, the continental United States or its outlying territories.

Location:

Remote (United States)

Work Schedule:

Full-time, remote. Must be available during core business hours (Eastern Time) to support stakeholder calls and submission deadlines. Occasional travel may be required.

Salary Range:

$115,000 to $140,000 annually, commensurate with experience

Position Overview:

AptNexus is seeking a Senior Cybersecurity Compliance Analyst to support a cybersecurity compliance program for our Department of Treasury customer. The program oversees the protection of sensitive federal data held by federal, state, and local government organizations, which submit corrective action plans, system security plans, technical inquiries, and change notifications for review. In this role, you will evaluate these submissions against security requirements tailored from NIST SP 800-53 and deliver clear, well-supported compliance determinations and guidance. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented self-starter who can manage a steady volume of reviews with consistency and precision.

Duties/Responsibilities:

• Evaluate corrective action plans and POA&Ms submitted by partner organizations, including supporting evidence such as screenshots, audit logs, and policy documents, and determine whether each finding is open or closed.

• Recommend specific follow-on actions required to close open findings, and address questions and statements raised in partner organization responses.

• Review system security plans and related compliance submissions against applicable NIST controls, clearly identify compliance status, and articulate applicable requirements.

• Prepare written responses to technical inquiries on topics such as multifactor authentication, cloud configuration, and control implementation methodologies, and conduct follow-up calls as needed.

• Evaluate advance notifications of planned changes, such as cloud adoption, contractor access, and test environments, and provide written cybersecurity guidance.

• Perform quality reviews of audit reports and remediation tracking documentation before delivery to the customer.

• Manage the submission review queue, tracking volumes, due dates, and turnaround to meet customer deadlines.

• Develop and maintain automated tools, such as Excel VBA macros and standardized templates, to improve the consistency and efficiency of reviews.

• Review the work of other analysts for accuracy and consistency, and provide technical guidance on complex determinations.

• Maintain complete and accurate records of all correspondence and documentation in the customer’s case management system.

• Contribute recommendations to improve review procedures, templates, and guidance.

• Comply with all customer security, privacy, and records management requirements, using only Government-furnished equipment and approved systems.

Required Skills

• Minimum of seven (7) years of cybersecurity experience, including at least five (5) years in federal cybersecurity compliance, audit, or assessment, with direct experience evaluating POA&Ms or system security plans.

• Expert working knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 (moderate and high baselines), the NIST Risk Management Framework, NIST SP 800-30, and FIPS, including the ability to evaluate compliance against control sets tailored from NIST.

title: Finance Integration Lead
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

When emagine welcomes a new company into the Group, finance is where integration becomes real. You'll work side by side with the acquired finance team. You'll help where it's needed, learn how the business really runs, and give Group Finance a clear view of risks, capacity and readiness.

You're the bridge in both directions. You explain what Group needs and why. You also make sure Group's plans reflect what the local team can deliver.

Between acquisitions, you'll support M&A, finance improvement and problem-solving projects across Group Finance.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Embed early: work with the local team to understand their accounting setup, close process, systems and workload.

- Support hands-on: help with Group requests, reconciliations and historical balance analysis. Dig into the detail when it unblocks the integration.

- Translate and prioritize: turn Group requirements into clear actions, bring local constraints back to Group, and flag material risks early.

- Build trust: become a credible, familiar Group Finance contact through regular on-site work.

- Share what you learn: document findings and handover knowledge, and feed lessons into the next acquisition.

WHO YOU ARE

- You have solid experience in accounting, financial controlling, audit or a similar finance role.

- You know GL accounting, balance sheets, month-end close and reconciliations well.

- You're comfortable with ERP systems and Excel, and you pick up new systems quickly.

- You've worked across teams, entities or countries, and with people at all levels.

- M&A, integration or due diligence experience is a plus, but not required.

You also bring:

- Independent judgement, and the courage to challenge constructively

- Curiosity, and no fear of asking basic questions

- A hands-on, low-ego approach

- Pragmatism, so you can tell real blockers from things that can wait

- Comfort with ambiguity and different cultures

- Clear communication with local and Group colleagues

HOW THE ROLE WORKS

- Travel is around 20-30%. During integrations, on-site periods can last several weeks, with time at home in between.

- This role supports the local team. It isn't a temporary GL accountant role, and it doesn't replace financial due diligence.

- You work with Group specialists in ERP, tax, treasury and reporting. They keep ownership of their areas.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- Risks are found early, not late.

- Group decisions reflect the acquired company's real situation.

- The local team finds Group Finance practical and easy to work with.

- Knowledge is handed over, and every integration improves the next.

DecisionPoint seeks an Endpoint Engineer to design, maintain, secure, automate, and modernize enterprise endpoint capabilities supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This senior engineering position owns endpoint images, application packaging, device provisioning, software deployment, endpoint patching, configuration baselines, and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure engineering.
The Endpoint Engineer develops standardized, repeatable, and secure endpoint solutions for geographically dispersed users and locations. The engineer supports physical and virtual endpoints throughout their lifecycle, including design, testing, deployment, configuration, patching, troubleshooting, refresh, recovery, and retirement.
This position works closely with the Task 6 cybersecurity team while maintaining a clear division of responsibility. Task 6 identifies, prioritizes, and validates security findings. The Endpoint Engineer evaluates operational impacts and implements the approved endpoint configuration, software, image, patch, or remediation changes through established change-control procedures. The engineer then provides deployment and completion evidence for cybersecurity validation.
The Endpoint Engineer collaborates with the Service Desk, field support, Active Directory, virtualization, cloud, network, application, cybersecurity, and Government teams. This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred. Occasional after-hours maintenance, critical incident support, on-site work, or travel may be required.

• Maintain image components, drivers, firmware dependencies, operating-system settings, security baselines, required software, and deployment configurations.

• Develop installation, detection, dependency, requirement, upgrade, repair, and removal logic for software packages.

• Test application packages for silent installation, proper detection, compatibility, security, user experience, and clean removal.

• Troubleshoot failed installations, package conflicts, missing dependencies, detection problems, and deployment errors.

• Develop approved scripts and automation for packaging, provisioning, configuration, deployment, validation, and remediation.

• Maintain endpoint-management automation in approved version-control and documentation repositories.

• Design and administer endpoint patching processes for operating systems, approved applications, drivers, firmware, and management components.

• Establish deployment rings, pilot groups, production waves, maintenance windows, deadlines, exception handling, and rollback procedures.

• Test operating-system updates, security patches, vendor patches, and application updates before production deployment.

• Monitor deployment progress, failure

description:
Job Spec: 3D Artist (Blender & Real-Time Specialist)

Location: Remote

Reporting to: Creative Director

The Role

We are looking for a versatile and technically proficient 3D Artist to join our growing creative team. You will be responsible for bringing complex concepts to life through high-quality modeling and fluid animation, primarily using Blender. As we specialize in interactive web-based demos, your primary challenge will be the "magic trick" of 3D: making assets look like high-end cinema while keeping them lightweight enough to load

instantly in a mobile browser. You will work under our Creative Director and alongside our development team to bridge the gap between high-fidelity art and web performance.

Key Responsibilities

• Modeling & Texturing: Create high-quality 3D assets optimized for performance. This includes expert-level retopology and baking high-to-low poly details.

• Animation: Develop smooth, purposeful animations-ranging from mechanical movements to

environmental storytelling-using Blender’s animation suite.

• Web Optimization: Ensure all assets are "game-ready" for the browser, focusing on low draw calls, efficient texture atlasing, and minimal file sizes.

• Collaboration: Work alongside other 3D artists and frontend developers to ensure visual consistency and technical compatibility.

• Pipeline Integration: Prepare and export assets (primarily glTF/GLB) that are ready for immediate implementation into our interactive platforms.

Technical Requirements

• Blender Mastery: Advanced proficiency in modeling, retopology, rigging, shading, and animation.

• Real-Time Optimization: Proven experience creating assets for web-based engines (Three.js, Babylon.js, or PlayCanvas). You should be an expert in:

○ Polygon Budgeting: Keeping mesh density low without losing silhouette.

○ Texture Compression: Efficient use of 1k/2k textures and PBR workflows.

○ Draw Call Reduction: Merging meshes and materials strategically.

• Visual Flair: A strong portfolio demonstrating a mastery of lighting and material creation.

Bonus Points

• Development Experience: Experience working directly within a dev sprint, using version control (Git), or understanding the limitations of WebGL.

• Technical Art: Knowledge of Python scripting within Blender to automate export pipelines.

• Material Science: Experience with KHR extensions for glTF (clearcoat, transmission, sheen) to achieve high-end looks in the browser.

Why Us?

We create virtual instrument simulations for lab equipment - helping people learn and service. We work with global biotech companies and we are always pushing boundaries with technical and creative ideas.

DEINE AUFGABEN

- Outbound und Inbound Sales: Du kombinierst die aktive Ansprache potenzieller Kund:innen über bereitgestellte Leads, telefonisch und vor Ort, mit der Bearbeitung eingehender Inbound-Anfragen. Dein Ziel ist es, qualifizierte Ersttermine zu vereinbaren und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu entwickeln.

Die Position ist vollständig auf die Gewinnung neuer Kund:innen ausgerichtet. Eine laufende Bestandskundenbetreuung gehört nicht zu Deinen Aufgaben.

DEIN PROFIL

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die oder der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen.

title: SEM Technician (f/m/d)
description:
Your Role

As an SEM Technician (f/m/d), you will support tools and process qualifications and help investigate issues arising across our semiconductor process flow. Working closely with our Failure Analysis Engineer, Process Integration team and other engineering functions, you will perform Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) analysis and complementary characterization using techniques such as Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDX) and Focused Ion Beam (FIB).

Ideally you come with a first-hand experience working with SEM. You will initially work alongside our SEM experts to deepen your knowledge learn the tool’s operating principles, procedures and inspection requirements for our specific use cases. Through hands-on training and continuous knowledge transfer, you will build your skills in sample handling, imaging, measurement and troubleshooting; before gradually becoming an independent SEM user and taking greater ownership of the tool and the processes.

As the function develops, there may also be opportunities to operate additional defect-inspection tools and support defect analysis and yield improvement within our 300 mm manufacturing facility.

What You’ll Do

- Prepare, handle and inspect a wide range of semiconductor samples according to defined analysis requirements

- Perform accurate and reliable SEM analysis to support tool qualification, process qualification and root-cause investigations

- Use complementary characterization techniques, including EDX and FIB, where required

- Work closely with Failure Analysis, Process Integration and engineering teams to understand inspection requirements and communicate results effectively across functions

- Maintain accurate records of incoming sample lots, expected outcomes, reporting deadlines and priorities

- Perform daily, weekly and monthly tool-health checks, calibration and routine performance monitoring

- Troubleshoot tool and measurement issues and coordinate with equipment vendors to maintain tool availability

- Maintain an accurate inventory of consumables and spare parts required for reliable SEM operation

- Standardize measurement procedures and reporting methods to ensure consistent and repeatable results

- Document operating procedures and best practices and, over time, support the training of additional SEM operators

- Support the operation of additional defect-inspection tools and contribute to defect analysis and yield-improvement activities as the team grows

What You Bring

- Technical training or a bachelor’s or master’s degree in physics, chemistry, engineering, materials science or a related field

- Previous hands-on experience operating SEM systems

- Experience with FIB and EDX is highly desirable

- An understanding of sample preparation, imaging, measurement and basic failure-analysis methods

- Previous experience working in a semiconductor cleanroom is an advantage

- Willingness and ability to spend extended periods working in a cleanroom while wearing the required PPE

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to work carefully and consistently with sensitive samples and equipment

- A structured approach to documentation, sample tracking and task prioritization

- Confidence working in a dynamic environment with interconnected technical dependencies and changing priorities

- Good communication skills in English, with a reliable, open and honest approach to working with stakeholders

- Willingness to learn, take increasing ownership and support tasks beyond your immediate scope when needed

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key-we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

title: Medical Chart Reviewer
description:
Role Title: Medical Chart Reviewer
Role Type: Contractor
Location : US - Remote
micro1 is engaging Medical Chart Reviewers (CCS / CIC / CPC certified, or RN / clinical background) to contribute their expertise to a dynamic project for a valued customer. In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required, your domain knowledge is what matters.
Scope of Work

• Review and audit medical charts, including admission notes, progress notes, operative reports, consults, lab and imaging results, and discharge summaries, to verify the accuracy and completeness of documentation and assigned codes.

• Validate diagnosis and procedure coding, sequencing, Present on Admission (POA) indicators, and MS-DRG assignment against the clinical documentation, identifying under-coding, over-coding, and missed CCs and MCCs.

• Apply clinical and coding standards, including the ICD-10-CM/PCS Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting, AHA Coding Clinic guidance, and clinical validation criteria, while flagging documentation gaps and query opportunities.

• Collaborate with project stakeholders using both written and verbal communication to clarify requirements, resolve documentation ambiguities, and ensure data integrity.

• Deliver high-quality feedback on charts, coding guidelines, and complex cases to support project workflow improvements and enhance AI model understanding.

• Ensure accuracy and completeness of all review findings per current best practices and coding standards.

Preferred Qualifications

• Active AHIMA Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), AAPC Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC), AAPC Certified Professional Coder (CPC), or an RN / clinical credential with chart review or CDI experience.

• Thorough expertise in ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, and MS-DRG methodology, with hands-on experience in chart review, coding audit, or clinical documentation improvement (CDI).

• Experience reviewing charts in diverse settings, such as acute care, teaching hospitals, specialty units, surgical, trauma, oncology, cardiology, and transplant cases.

• Proficiency in reviewing various types of clinical documentation and identifying discrepancies or complex coding challenges.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, demonstrating meticulous attention to detail and clarity.

• Access to current ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS code sets, Official Coding Guidelines, and MS-DRG grouper tools.

Abnormal is a channel-first company: nearly all of our transactions run through partners, which makes partner readiness a direct driver of revenue. Baseten is building a new cloud for AI. Our ambition is to make inference, training, and agent execution part of one coherent platform, and to shape how the next generation of AI products gets built. THE ROLE

Shape how AI infrastructure is priced, packaged, and sold.

AI infrastructure is changing fast, and the way customers pay for it is evolving just as quickly. Tokens, GPUs, reserved capacity, training jobs, agent execution. Different workloads have different economics, and traditional cloud pricing models don't always fit.

We're looking for a Product Manager to lead pricing and monetization across Baseten's platform.

You'll help determine how we package our products, measure usage, price new capabilities, and make it easier for customers to understand and manage their spend.

This is a rare opportunity to influence both how customers experience our platform and how the business grows.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own pricing and packaging strategy across inference, training, sandboxes, Grid, and future products.

- Design pricing models for token-based inference, dedicated deployments, reserved capacity, and emerging AI workloads.

- Work with engineering and finance to understand infrastructure costs, GPU utilization, margins, and usage patterns.

- Partner with sales, finance, and product teams to bring pricing changes to market and manage customer transitions.

- Identify opportunities to improve adoption, revenue growth, and unit economics.

REQUIREMENTS

- 10+ years of experience in pricing, packaging, or monetization for cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, or complex usage-based products.

- A track record of owning meaningful pricing decisions, from strategy and modeling through launch and adoption.

- Experience with both self-serve and enterprise pricing, including commitments, consumption models, and commercial negotiations.

- Strong analytical skills, including hands-on work with SQL, financial models, usage data, and customer cohorts.

- A deep understanding of how pricing influences customer behavior, product adoption, and business economics.

- The ability to work across product, engineering, finance, and GTM to turn complex pricing decisions into simple customer experiences.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience pricing AI/ML infrastructure, GPU compute, model APIs, or other emerging developer platforms.

- Familiarity with inference economics, including utilization, caching, retries, and serving costs.

title: Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, C
description:
Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Cyprus
Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Cyprus. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.
The programme
An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.
You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.
What you will work on
Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.
What you bring
Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.
Useful but not essential:
Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.
How to respond
Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.
About Yadimen
Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

Packed with intuitive functionality, CompanyCam facilitates unparalleled communication and accountability across a contractor’s entire business. By providing a consumer-grade, game-changing experience, we help contractors build trust within their company and with their users.

CompanyCam is a fun, energetic team united by our core values of Show Up, Grow Up, and Do Good. As soon as you join our team, you'll notice that we trust our employees to do what's best for our product, customers, and team members and empower them to make the right calls.

The Senior Graphic Designer plays a pivotal role in shaping design at CompanyCam, elevating how brand, product, and campaigns communicate and feel across every channel. You'll blend high-end craftsmanship with creative leadership, transforming visual content, aligning it to strategic objectives, and strengthening overall brand consistency. Working cross-functionally with brand, product, and marketing teams, you'll help define how design supports both user experience and brand expression, mentor others, build scalable systems, and push design forward through new tools and storytelling approaches. Reporting into creative leadership, you'll move fluidly between independently owning projects from brief intake to final delivery, and collaborating closely with design leadership to produce high-caliber, on-brand work that drives strategy forward.

Location: We welcome both local and remote applicants for this role. Local (Lincoln, NE) is preferred. Candidates must permanently live and work in the U.S. to be considered.

- Own projects independently from brief to final delivery, making sound creative decisions within a brief's parameters with minimal supervision or revision cycles

- Create visual assets for digital and print media including campaigns, product launches, web, social, email, and events, working primarily in Adobe Creative Suite with supplemental use of Figma

- Apply strong typography, layout, and color skills to adapt designs across channels while keeping visual consistency and production readiness

- Use AI tools to accelerate production work like asset generation, format adaptation, and templating, freeing up your time for the creative judgment no tool replaces

- Partner with Marketing, Product Design, and Internal Brand teams, collaborating with motion designers, copywriters, and marketing partners to turn strategy into cohesive visuals

- Present design concepts and gather feedback, iterating efficiently across multiple stakeholders

- Ensure all creative aligns with brand guidelines, auditing deliverables for consistency in typography, color, and tone

- Maintain and evolve shared design systems and asset libraries across Adobe Libraries, Figma, Canva, and Bynder

- Pressure-test every brief before execution begins, surfacing gaps and creative risks before they become revision loops

- Model high creative standards and lead the team's AI tool adoption, building and sharing workflows that help everyone move faster

THE IMPACT YOU'LL HAVE

At CompanyCam, your work makes a real impact. Whether you're writing code, supporting customers, or designing experiences, your contributions directly shape the product we deliver and the people we serve. We're building something that helps real people solve real problems-and we believe that kind of work is best done by a team that reflects the world around us. In this role, you’ll drive impact by:

- Strengthening brand consistency across every channel, so our marketing, product, and internal communications feel like one cohesive voice

- Building scalable design systems and templates that empower non-designers to create confidently and stay on-brand

- Mentoring and raising the bar on craft across the creative team, setting the standard for what great design looks like at CompanyCam

title: Senior Financial Analyst, Commercial Finance
description:
Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission - to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders - only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role: Mozilla Finance partners with business units to drive strategic resource allocation and financial insight across our product portfolio. Our team of analysts supports revenue and cost ownership across Search, Advertising, Firefox, Marketing, and New Products.

We're adding a commercially-minded analyst will cover three areas: New Products (revenue and costs for B2B and SaaS-type initiatives), Ads revenue analysis in partnership with our Data Science team, and Marketing cost including labor and program spend reconciliation through close.

Beyond ownership of those areas, you'll contribute to the team's broader push to standardize how we plan and report. This role reports to the Senior Director, Finance and works alongside three senior analysts.

The right person has done commercial finance in a B2B environment, is comfortable working with data scientists, and doesn't wait to be asked before making something better.

What you'll do:

•
Own New Products financials : Maintain the forecast for New Products revenue and costs (labor + program spend). Validate inputs, reconcile actuals through close, and document drivers. Maintain position-level detail on how labor is forecasted and reported

•
B2B Financial Modelling. Once a B2B deal or New Products initiative is live, maintain an ongoing financial model, updating commercial assumptions as the business evolves. Keep operating view current as actuals come in and support with ad hoc scenarios as needed.

•
Support Ads revenue analysis. Partner with Data Science to conduct deep-dive research into Ads revenue trends, building the analytical frameworks and recurring views that help the business understand performance and pursue growth. Translate findings into clear insights .

•
Marketing cost reconciliation. Support reconciliation of Marketing program spend, coordinating with the Marketing cost lead to ensure accuracy through close and flagging issues before they compound.

•
Drive team standardization and reporting : Help build shared processes and templates so results can be presented as a unified view.

•
Be a reliable business partner. Field data and reporting questions, anticipate stakeholder needs, and communicate complex information in terms non-finance partners can use - escalating items that call for a broader partnership discussion.

•
Apply AI and automation to recurring work: Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort across forecast, close, and reporting cycles.

What you'll bring: Core Experience

• 3-5 years of experience in commercial finance, B2B finance, FP&A, or a comparable analytical finance role, including hands-on work through a full budget and forecast cycle with close and variance analysis.

• B2B commercial experience required. Familiarity with revenue modeling, deal economics, or partner, SaaS, or subscription revenue models in a B2B context.

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

title: Lead Web Designer
description:
About Us

Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books - all in one connected platform backed by real human support.

About the role

Most company websites are brochures. A hero, three feature tiles, a logo wall, a demo button. They get redesigned every few years and forgotten every few weeks in between.

Ours shouldn't be. For most founders, rho.co http://rho.co is the first time they meet us. It's where they decide whether we feel like a bank they'd trust with their company's money, long before they talk to anyone. That first impression is either doing the work for us or working against us.

We're hiring a Lead Web Designer to reimagine the entire site. Not a refresh. A rebuild of how Rho shows up in the world, from the homepage to every product page, pricing, our tools, our comparisons, our blog and our careers page.

We want rho.co http://rho.co to feel like the most considered financial brand on the internet. Calm, confident and alive. Restraint over decoration. Every page earns its place. If you've read this far and you're already thinking about what you'd change about our homepage, we should talk.

What you'll do

You'll own rho.co http://rho.co end to end. The story, the structure, the visual language, the motion and the details, all the way to production.

- Reimagine the whole site. Rethink the information architecture, the narrative and the visual system from first principles. What a founder needs to understand, in what order, and how it should feel.

- Make the product the hero. Show what Rho actually does with real, considered product moments rather than stock illustrations and vague promises.

- Build a system, not a set of pages. Define the layouts, type, color, components and motion that let the site scale across dozens of product, solution and comparison pages without losing its voice.

- Design in the real medium. You work in code and in our CMS, not just in static mocks. What you design is what ships.

- Sweat the details. Type that's set with care. Motion that has a reason. Pages that load fast and feel calm. The 404 page that somebody actually smiles at.

- Measure it. Partner with marketing and growth on what the site needs to achieve, and judge your work on whether more of the right founders sign up.

Who you are

You've been doing this for a while: at least 6 years designing and shipping marketing sites and brand experiences, with a portfolio that is visibly, unusually crafted. We need to see it. Live sites we can open, scroll and feel.

You are the kind of person who:

- Treats a website like a product. You think about structure, flow and outcomes, not just how a page looks in a screenshot.

- Has real typographic and editorial taste. You can make a page of words feel beautiful, and you know when to get out of the way.

- Brings motion with restraint. You know when an interaction makes a page feel alive and when it's just noise.

- Builds what you design. You're comfortable in code, a modern CMS, or both, and you care how the thing behaves on a phone at 7am on a slow connection.

- Can tell a complicated story simply. Banking, cards, treasury and bill pay are dense. You find the clear, human way to explain them.

- Can't turn your taste off. You notice the misaligned baseline on other people's sites, and you've rebuilt your own site more times than you'd admit.

Who this is not for

- Product designers who want a side project. This is a full time, high craft role focused entirely on the website.

- Template designers. If your best work is a theme with the logo swapped, this isn't the one.

- Anyone who needs the brief written for them. You'll help define what the site needs to say and do.

- People who think "good enough, ship it" is the standard for a homepage. Not here.

Our people are our most valuable asset. The salary range for this role is $110,000 - $150,000.

title: Site Budget & Contract Maintenance Specialist with DACH expertise
description:
Join Our Team and Help Keep Clinical Trials Moving

At Fortrea , we are committed to making clinical trials more efficient and helping bring life-changing therapies to patients.
As a Site Budget & Contract Maintenance Specialist , you will manage contracts and budgets for active clinical trial sites throughout the study lifecycle. This home-based opportunity is open to candidates located in Switzerland.

This role goes beyond initial contract and budget negotiation. You will assess the impact of protocol amendments and other study changes, establish timelines and priorities with study teams, and execute the required Clinical Trial Agreement (CTA) and budget amendments.

You will be part of our Functional Service Provider (FSP) team , working directly with one of our key pharmaceutical sponsors to support innovative clinical research.

Key Responsibilities
In this role, you will:

• Manage site contracts and budgets throughout the active study lifecycle , including ongoing maintenance and amendments.

• Review protocol amendments and other study changes , assess their impact on existing site contracts and budgets, and determine the actions required.

• Prepare, negotiate, and execute CTA and budget amendments with clinical trial sites.

• Partner with study leads to establish timelines, prioritize sites, and sequence amendment activities according to study needs.

• Manage a portfolio of active sites , tracking contract and budget changes, timelines, outstanding actions, and execution status.

• Communicate with sites and internal stakeholders regarding contractual and budgetary changes, resolving issues and escalating risks or delays when necessary .

• Maintain accurate documentation and status information in relevant systems, ensuring compliance with applicable procedures, contractual requirements, and clinical research standards.

Required Qualifications
To succeed in this role, you should have:

• Relevant experience in clinical trial site contracting and budgeting , ideally within a pharmaceutical company, Contract Research Organization (CRO), or similar clinical research environment.

• Demonstrated experience managing contracts and budgets after site activation , rather than experience limited to initial negotiation.

• Experience reviewing protocol amendments or other study changes and translating them into required contract and budget amendments.

• Strong understanding of Clinical Trial Agreements, site budgets, amendment processes, and the clinical trial lifecycle .

• Experience managing multiple active sites and competing priorities against study-specific timelines.

• Confidence working directly with sites, study teams, legal teams, and other stakeholders to resolve contractual or budget-related issues and escalations.

•
Fluency in German and English. Relevant university education is preferred, although equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

What We Offer

• The opportunity to work within an established FSP partnership supporting innovative clinical research.

• Flexible, home-based working arrangements in Switzerland.

• Professional development and career growth within a global clinical research organization.

• A collaborative environment with exposure to clinical study teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

• The opportunity to play a direct role in keeping active clinical trials and sites moving forward.

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you have strong clinical trial contracting and budgeting experience and enjoy managing the ongoing complexities of active studies , we would like to hear from you.

title: Développeur Salesforce Marketing Cloud Senior (CDI ou freelance)
description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités
Dans le cadre de l’évolution d’un environnement CRM centré sur Salesforce Marketing Cloud, le rôle consiste à reprendre la maintenance et à assurer le développement continu de la plateforme.
Objectifs de la mission
Garantir la stabilité, l’évolutivité et les performances des campagnes marketing digitales, tout en développant de nouveaux parcours clients, en optimisant les traitements de données et en assurant l’intégration avec l’écosystème Salesforce.
Responsabilités principales

• Assurer la maintenance évolutive et corrective de la plateforme Marketing Cloud.

• Concevoir, développer et mettre en œuvre des parcours clients personnalisés.

• Créer des requêtes, des scripts, des composants dynamiques et des automatisations complexes.

• Optimiser les campagnes sur la base de leurs performances et des retours utilisateurs.

• Contribuer à l’intégration et à la fiabilité des flux de données avec les autres composants de l’écosystème Salesforce.

La personne rejoindra une équipe pluridisciplinaire et travaillera de manière collaborative, avec une attention portée à la qualité, à la performance et à l’expérience client.
Soft skills attendus

•
Travail en équipe : collaborer étroitement avec les équipes CRM et marketing.

•
Adaptabilité : s’intégrer rapidement dans un environnement structuré et en évolution constante.

•
Curiosité technique : proposer de nouvelles solutions et explorer de bonnes pratiques de manière autonome.

•
Rigueur : produire un code propre, documenté, performant et facile à maintenir.

Compétences techniques indispensables

•
Salesforce Marketing Cloud : maîtriser Email Studio, Automation Studio, Journey Builder, Contact Builder et Cloud Pages.

•
SQL avancé : gérer et manipuler des Data Extensions complexes.

•
Développement front-end : utiliser HTML et CSS pour créer des emails responsives et dynamiques.

•
Scripting : maîtriser AMPscript et SSJS pour la personnalisation et l’automatisation des campagnes.

•
JavaScript : développer des fonctionnalités pour les Cloud Pages et des traitements personnalisés.

• Connaître MC Connect ainsi que la gestion des Data Extensions synchronisées.

• Connaître le SDK Mobile pour l’intégration avec des applications mobiles Android et iOS.

• Maîtriser le développement Salesforce Marketing Cloud et les différents composants de la plateforme.

Salesforce Sales Cloud

• Bonne connaissance des objets standards et personnalisés.

• Capacité à gérer les flux, les déclencheurs, les flows et l’intégration des données via API ou batch.

Développement front-end des emails

• Très bonne maîtrise de HTML et CSS pour le développement d’emails responsives.

• Compréhension des contraintes de rendu entre les différents clients de messagerie, notamment pour le Dark Mode et la compatibilité.

Connaissances complémentaires attendues

• Bonne compréhension de Salesforce Core, notamment des échanges de données entre systèmes.

• Expérience dans l’utilisation et l’optimisation d’Automation Studio et de Journey Builder.

• Bonne maîtrise des API Marketing Cloud pour les intégrations de données externes.

Tâches à réaliser plus en détail

• Définir les spécifications techniques sur la base des besoins métiers.

• Développer les modules techniques et implémenter les user stories.

• Concevoir et implémenter des journeys complexes dans Journey Builder, avec SQL, ciblages et triggers.

• Créer et optimiser des templates d’emails HTML et CSS compatibles avec les différents clients de messagerie, y compris le Dark Mode.

• Intégrer de nouvelles sources de données dans Sales Cloud.

• Implémenter de nouveaux modèles de consentement opt-in et opt-out conformes au RGPD.

• Auditer et améliorer la synchronisation entre Sales Cloud et Marketing Cloud.

• Élaborer et exécuter des tests unitaires et d’intégration.

• Assurer le support des tests E2E, SIT et UAT.

• Gérer les déploiements et le release management.

• Corriger les anomalies détectées pendant les campagnes de tes
